memos_so_far.headline: Mixed and industry-wide: strong Q3 profit, lower sales guide on mortgage volumes; no consensus to measure
reasoning: Source: UWM's preliminary Q3 (Benzinga 12:35 UTC): 'UWM Holdings Reports Preliminary Q3 Net Income Of $205M-$220M And Sales Of $800M-$825M; Lowers FY26 Total Sales Guidance To ~$3.35B-$3.50B Due To Lower Origination Volume Throughout The Industry'.

What changed: the full-year revenue outlook is lower because mortgage originations slowed across the industry, a rate-driven trend visible to everyone; the quarter's profit is solid. No consensus figures in our sources, so neither number can be called a surprise.
The cause is market-wide, so the read-across is to the whole sector rather than to UWM specifically.
objections: Mixed: industry-wide volume decline, solid profit, no consensus to measure against.
